data.name: Remove Carbon Today
data.description: Remove Carbon Today is an online retail storefront that enables individuals to purchase certified, durable carbon removal credits. It aggregates small customer purchases and retires Puro.earth CO₂ Removal Certificates (CORCs) on their behalf, sourcing removals from third-party supplier partners. The company does not operate its own removal technology.
